bends.reason: B1 (seq 1). FORMED in the CAD direction, not reversed. bend_01: at the bend line the scan outline turns and closes around the blue FORMED leg (about 9 mm). No scan points lie on the orange flat continuation. bend_02 far end: the scan also follows the formed B1 hook there. Raw SIDE (no CAD): one long edge of the web carries a ~90 deg leg with a rounded corner, on the opposite face from the end flange, which is how B1 relates to B3 in the CAD. Raw and overlay TOP: a dense edge-on flange line runs the full length of the B1 edge. Caveat: the blank looks symmetric about its long centre line. The CAD hole rings mark one face, but the scan shows plain holes, so B1 vs B2 rests on the registration, which needs no reversed bend; it has no LOW CONFIDENCE flag, and the holes, tab and end flange line up. The only other reading is B2 formed reversed, B3 reversed and B1 flat.

B2 (seq 2). NOT_FORMED. bend_02: the scan runs straight through the bend line and closes around the orange NOT FORMED flat flange (about 6 mm). No scan points lie on the blue formed leg. bend_01 far end: the parent runs on flat past the B2 position with no hook. Raw SIDE: the long edge opposite the formed leg extends flat, in the plane of the web, beyond the end flange's width, with no leg to either face. Raw and overlay TOP: the scan surface continues past the B2 bend line along the full length, with a chamfered outer corner at the B3 end. In overlay SIDE the only thing standing on the B2 line is the faint bluish CAD flange, with no grey scan points. The same B1/B2 symmetry caveat applies (see B1).

B3 (seq 3). FORMED in the CAD direction. By design B3 bends to the opposite face from B1/B2, so it is reverse-direction relative to them. The scan matches that design: B3 is not reversed against the CAD. bend_03: the scan follows the blue FORMED leg (about 20 mm) at the bend line, with no points on the orange flat continuation. Raw views: the short-end flange is folded ~90 deg with a rounded corner. It shows edge-on in TOP, face-on in SIDE and folded in FRONT and ISO, on the opposite face from the formed long leg. The hole spacing (0.50 and 0.66 of the length from this end) and the tab at the far end show this is the B3 end. Overlay TOP: the edge-on flange bar sits on the green B3 line.
